_meta.description: Builder-owned WUBRG-vector-first Gate source for the live Archscry Gate. Generated placement scoring must be derived from this source, not hand-authored here.
_meta.ordinary_expression_rule: Ordinary color-bearing expressions receive evidence only through answer color_loadings propagated over WUBRG colors.
_meta.colorless_rule: COLORLESS receives evidence only through answer-level outside_wubrg.
_meta.wubrg_rule: WUBRG receives evidence only through answer-level all_five_integration.

scoring.bucket_contract: Use the current placement model likelihood_to_delta table; bucket propagated deltas to the nearest existing likelihood before scoring.

questions.prompt: When the ground shifts, what do you trust first?

answers.title: The claim no one can make for me
answers.copy: I start with agency: the private decision, the necessary edge, the first motion I can own.

answers.title: The threshold in the self
answers.copy: I listen for the moment where desire, danger, and choice become too clear to outsource.

answers.title: A braided witness
answers.copy: I want each part of the situation named, given weight, and brought into one accountable center.

answers.title: The common root
answers.copy: I trust the pattern that keeps people, place, and continuity from splintering under strain.

answers.title: The measure outside the map
answers.copy: I trust the constraint that does not ask the old language for permission before it becomes real.

questions.prompt: When pressure gathers, what should it become?

answers.title: A form that can hold
answers.copy: Pressure should become structure: named, testable, and steady enough to keep harm from spreading.

answers.title: Answerable motion
answers.copy: It should move, but with a visible thread back to responsibility, memory, and consequence.

answers.title: Many currents, one course
answers.copy: It should become a working convergence: different forces kept distinct, then aimed together.

answers.title: A wild release
answers.copy: It should become adaptation, appetite, heat, and movement before a brittle answer snaps shut.

answers.title: A silent axis
answers.copy: It should become a hard boundary: not loud, not ornamental, simply outside the usual bargain.

answers.title: The cold pattern
answers.copy: Before the room gets loud, I notice leverage, implication, and what the facts are already costing.

answers.title: The measured trace
answers.copy: I look for the thread beneath the feeling: the sign that tells me what kind of change is possible.

answers.title: The whole chord
answers.copy: The signal arrives as a chord: thought, hunger, duty, feeling, and life all audible at once.

answers.title: The live spark
answers.copy: I hear what wants to move: the heat, the honesty, the flash before it gets explained away.

answers.title: The unlit edge
answers.copy: The first signal is absence: a clean edge where the usual symbols stop being useful.

questions.prompt: What cost can an oath fairly ask of you?

answers.title: Preserve what must not break
answers.copy: It can ask me to carry the old weight: shelter, consequence, and the line that keeps faith intact.

answers.title: Steward the change
answers.copy: It can ask discipline from me: not refusal of change, but care over what change consumes.

answers.title: Keep the whole covenant
answers.copy: It can ask me to hold every claim in view, even when no single hunger deserves the throne.

answers.title: Become the changed thing
answers.copy: It can ask me to release the prior shape and become the answer the threshold requires.

answers.title: Stand where the lamp does not reach
answers.copy: It can ask a clean refusal: no borrowed brightness, no decorated answer, only the boundary kept.
